ui_rules: Show the dispatch backfill action only for uncancelled Xianyu status 21 or 22 orders.
Use an Element Plus dialog with visible labels for actual device, existing waybill, carrier, actual ship time, and reason.
Display explicit warning copy that the action only restores local device, schedule, shipment, and delivery records and never calls the remote shipment API.
Keep the dialog open and preserve form values after server failure; close and refresh only after an accepted response.
Support desktop and narrow layouts with non-color status/error communication.
architecture_modules: camera-rental-server/yudao-module-rental-biz: XianyuOrderController, XianyuOrderDispatchBackfillReqVO, XianyuOrderShipService.backfillDispatch, RentalDeviceShipmentMapper, and service tests.
camera-rental-admin: typed Xianyu API, order page action, XianyuDispatchBackfillDialog, and zh-CN/en locale dictionaries.
api_contracts: POST /admin-api/rental/xianyu/order/dispatch-backfill with channelOrderId, deviceId or deviceNo, idempotencyKey, expressCode, expressName, waybillNo, consignTime, and reason.
Response reuses XianyuOrderShipRespVO and returns local shipment, delivery, device, source, and assignment status.
The endpoint is a local-only mutation and must not emit XianGuanJia HTTP requests.
database_entities: xianyu_order: lock eligible channel order and update local waybill, carrier, consignTime, and missing shipDate.
rental_order and rental_order_item: create through existing conversion when needed; current scope selects the first rental order item.
rental_device, rental_device_assignment, and rental_schedule: create/reuse assignment and occupied schedule, then persist RENTED/DISPATCHED states.
rental_device_shipment: create ADMIN_BACKFILL evidence with idempotency and business-key conflict checks.
rental_delivery: create/reuse outbound delivery with shipment-backfill source identifier.
permissions: rental:xianyu:ship: existing backend permission reused by the admin action and dispatch-backfill endpoint.
Existing tenant isolation applies; no new role, permission code, menu migration, or user-to-shop data-scope policy is introduced.
operational_constraints: No physical scanner, camera, or staff mobile app is required.
Eligible channel statuses are exactly 21 and 22; cancelled, refunded, closed, or pending orders are rejected.
Do not read Xianyu write-enabled configuration and do not invoke XianyuWriteClient.
All local mutations execute transactionally and use existing row-lock, assignment, scheduling, and delivery idempotency mechanisms.
Business dates are interpreted in Asia/Shanghai.
No database migration or configuration change.
Accepted limitation: authorization is tenant-level rather than user-to-shop data-level.
Accepted limitation: one waybill cannot bind multiple devices under the existing shipment business key.
Accepted limitation: multi-item orders use the first rental order item.
data_flows: FLOW-XIANYU-DISPATCH-BACKFILL: eligible order row -> Web dialog -> typed local API -> tenant/order/device/idempotency validation -> optional conversion -> assignment/schedule -> local dispatch -> ADMIN_BACKFILL shipment -> outbound delivery -> channel order logistics update -> refreshed list.
No external-channel request exists in this flow.
